name: cannon-alerts-mobs
description: D-149: a Hand Cannon shot is heard 60 m around (NoiseRules.CannonShotRadius). A Greydwarf 25 m to the side starts hunting the player, a Greydwarf Brute 85 m to the other side does not hear it. The player is in ghost mode, so the mobs react to the noise, not to seeing the player; both stand off the line of fire.

steps.name: GunPowdered.noiseLast
steps.regex: hand cannon shot at .*radius 60 m, alerted [1-9]
steps.label: the shot alerts mobs within 60 m

steps.name: GunPowdered.noiseCreature
steps.label: the Greydwarf 25 m away hunts the player

steps.name: GunPowdered.noiseCreature
steps.label: the Brute 85 m away did not hear it
